firstPlayerRule: In standard play, whoever drank tea most recently starts, or choose randomly. In the optional experienced-player variant, the lowest-numbered starting tile determines who starts.
officialTieBreak: Random selection is an official alternative to the tea criterion, not a stated tie-break sequence.
clarifications: The selected starter receives the teapot and chooses an initial map position first. During play, turns proceed clockwise.
